headline: AI Demand Fuels Singapore Industrial Property Price and Rental Gains in Q3 2026
summary: Demand related to artificial intelligence lifted prices and rents for Singapore industrial space in the third quarter of 2026. Approximately 300,000 square meters of new industrial capacity is scheduled for completion in the fourth quarter.
why: Singapore serves as a prime Southeast Asian tech hub where industrial and data center real estate is regulated by the statutory agency JTC Corporation.

impacts.name: Singapore Real Estate
impacts.why: Expanding artificial intelligence requirements support occupancy and leasing rates across industrial facilities.
